import pytest
if pytest.use_correct:
    from correct_python_programs.shunting_yard import shunting_yard
else:
    from python_programs.shunting_yard import shunting_yard


def test_attack_1():
    # left-associativity of same low precedence: (10-5)-2
    assert shunting_yard([10, '-', 5, '-', 2]) == [10, 5, '-', 2, '-']


def test_attack_2():
    # precedence: * binds tighter than + : 2+(3*4)
    assert shunting_yard([2, '+', 3, '*', 4]) == [2, 3, 4, '*', '+']


def test_attack_3():
    # higher precedence first, then lower: (2*3)+4
    assert shunting_yard([2, '*', 3, '+', 4]) == [2, 3, '*', 4, '+']


def test_attack_4():
    # left-associativity of same high precedence: (20/2)*3 and (8/4)/2
    assert shunting_yard([20, '/', 2, '*', 3]) == [20, 2, '/', 3, '*']
    assert shunting_yard([8, '/', 4, '/', 2]) == [8, 4, '/', 2, '/']
    assert shunting_yard([2, '*', 3, '*', 4]) == [2, 3, '*', 4, '*']


def test_attack_5():
    # docstring long mixed chain
    assert shunting_yard([4, '+', 9, '*', 9, '-', 10, '+', 13]) == [4, 9, 9, '*', '+', 10, '-', 13, '+']


def test_attack_6():
    # docstring: division before subtraction + mixed +- chain
    assert shunting_yard([34, '-', 12, '/', 5]) == [34, 12, 5, '/', '-']
    assert shunting_yard([5, '+', 6, '-', 7, '+', 8]) == [5, 6, '+', 7, '-', 8, '+']


def test_attack_7():
    # trivial cases: empty, single number, single operator
    assert shunting_yard([]) == []
    assert shunting_yard([42]) == [42]
    assert shunting_yard([7, '+', 8]) == [7, 8, '+']
    assert shunting_yard([7, '-', 8]) == [7, 8, '-']
    assert shunting_yard([7, '*', 8]) == [7, 8, '*']
    assert shunting_yard([7, '/', 8]) == [7, 8, '/']


def test_attack_8():
    # negative ints and zero are numbers, not operators
    assert shunting_yard([0, '*', -5, '+', 10]) == [0, -5, '*', 10, '+']
    assert shunting_yard([-3, '+', 4]) == [-3, 4, '+']
    assert shunting_yard([10, '-', -5]) == [10, -5, '-']
